title: Ma La Chicken Stir Fry
description: A spicy Sichuan dish made with marinated chicken, peanuts, and chili peppers.

ingredients.name: yellow Chinese chili peppers
ingredients.notes: also known as Sichuan hot peppers

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Sichuan hot peppers and cook for another minute.
Add the ma la sauce and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Return the cooked chicken to the wok and stir-fry until coated with the sauce.
Season with tang chicken seasoning to taste.
Serve immediately and garnish with chopped peanuts and Sichuan hot peppers if desired.
